description:
File: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/chat.rs:194-200
Issue: handle_chat_query_changes parses no filter or sort from the request args and hard-codes None, None in the backend call. The generic handle_query_changes in jmap-server does parse and forward these fields. The Chat-specific implementation was written without the generic handler having existed at the time, and was not updated to delegate or document the omission.
Risk: Clients sending filter or sort fields in Chat/queryChanges will have them silently ignored — the query returns results as if no filter was given. If a future backend adds filter support for Chat/queryChanges, the handler layer will never pass the filter through. The inconsistency with handle_query_changes (which does pass filter/sort) means different object types behave differently with no visible documentation of the difference.
Fix: Either delegate to jmap_server::handlers::handle_query_changes::<Chat, B>(backend, args) (the same pattern used for handle_chat_changes), or explicitly reject filter/sort with an error if Chat/queryChanges is intentionally filterless, with a doc comment explaining why.
title: handle_chat_query_changes silently drops filter and sort
